titles.title: Black Patio Door

description: A tan adobe wall, seen from an angle, stretches across the canvas. A rectangular black form interrupts the smooth expanse of the adobe. The black form denotes a door set within the wall. A small triangle of gray sky is visible on the upper left corner of the composition.
